query:
SELECT ua.id, ua.action_type, ua.description, ua.dxf_url, ua.image_url, ua.segment_count, ua.feature, ua.created_at
FROM user_actions ua
JOIN app_users u ON ua.appUserId = u.id
WHERE u.email = 'liad118811@gmail.com'
ORDER BY ua.created_at DESC
LIMIT 10;
